policies.sentence: Students must not paste or upload assignment text, instructions, or questions into AI tools.
Students must not upload, post, or share their own code with AI tools or chatbots.
Students must not upload or paste course materials, including copyrighted or protected ones, into AI tools.
Students must not upload solutions to AI platforms or websites.
No files or images may be uploaded to the university's Gemini.
Students should not have their code or assignment open while interacting with an AI assistant.
Students should share the project spec with AI only in their own words.
Students must not post any portion of an exam to AI services or online platforms.
